purpose: Agriculture as a measured and lived system of crops, livestock, land, water, labor, markets, and local knowledge.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name crop, farm system, place, season, and comparison. Distinguish trial results from local advice; respect land rights and local knowledge, and verify safety guidance before production.
